_comment: HEAVY lifecycle — covers all 24 autoscaling-group endpoints (compute/virtualserver). Requires SCP_RUN_HEAVY=true. Creates: keypair, LC, SG, VPC, subnet, ASG (desired_server_count=0 to avoid billable VMs), policy, schedule, notification — exercises all 24 endpoints — then tears down in reverse order. Service account user id f2b627e6bf4f4b3996f04de4f877bd11 used for notification user_ids.

lifecycles._note: Full autoscaling lifecycle: creates all resources with desired_server_count=0 (no billable VMs spin up), exercises all 24 ASG endpoints in the catalog, then tears down. notification user_ids=[f2b627e6bf4f4b3996f04de4f877bd11] (service account user id confirmed from GET /v1/access-keys). Notification id capture: $.notifications[0].id (list envelope). update-asg body: all optional per model autoscalinggroupsetrequestv1dot2. update-policy body: all optional per autoscalinggrouppolicyupdaterequestv1dot2. update-schedule body: all optional per autoscalinggroupscheduleupdaterequest. update-notification body: {notification_events, notification_state} per autoscalinggroupnotificationupdaterequest.

steps.name: list-asg-initial
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggroups (GET with params -> catalog key credit).

steps.name: get-image
steps._note: Seed a real standard image id for the LC. Picks first standard image.

steps.name: create-keypair
steps._note: Create a throwaway keypair for the LC. SCP generates the key pair; name is the only required field.

steps.name: create-launch-configuration
steps._note: PROVEN 2xx (2026-06-19). Any standard image works. volume size divisible by 8; no delete_on_termination field. Captures launch_configuration_id from flat $.id.

steps.name: show-launch-configuration
steps._note: 2026-07-08 owner: gen-wave4-asg 은퇴로 이 유일-커버 endpoint(showlaunchconfiguration)를 full-coverage 로 이관 — 방금 만든 LC 단건조회 strict 200.

steps.name: list-launch-configurations
steps._note: 2026-07-08 25-편입(owner GO): listlaunchconfigurations.

steps.name: create-security-group
steps._note: Create a throwaway SG for the ASG. Returns $.security_group.id.

steps.name: create-vpc
steps._note: Create a VPC for the ASG subnet. Budget: 4 free. CIDR 10.175.0.0/20 (unique range). Poll state->ACTIVE.

steps.name: wait-vpc-active
steps._note: Poll until VPC ACTIVE before creating subnet.

steps.name: create-subnet
steps._note: Create a subnet in the VPC. CIDR 10.175.8.0/24. Poll state->ACTIVE.

steps.name: wait-subnet-active
steps._note: Poll until subnet ACTIVE before creating ASG.

steps.name: create-auto-scaling-group
steps._note: HEAVY: creates ASG with desired_server_count=0 so no billable VMs are spun up. min=0, max=1. Captures $.id (flat, not nested). security_group_ids array (not security_groups). subnet_ids array. SPEC-DIFF-20260715 §2① (v1.4): placement_strategy(required, docs example 'balanced') + zones(required array) added; zone convention '{region}-b' — LIVE 2026-07-15: this account/region has exactly ONE availability zone 'kr-west1-b' (volume create with the docs-example 'kr-west1-a' 400d Volume.InvalidAvailabilityZone (must be one of availability zones: ['kr-west1-b'], req-e8a99e6e)); the docs example kr-west1-a is NOT valid here. Without them: 400 ValidationError naming BOTH placement_strategy (Example: balanced) and zones (req-a10e06f4). With placement_strategy=balanced + zones=['kr-west1-b'] the 400 moved to the resource stage (InvalidAutoScalingGroupLaunchConfigurationId, req-4f363bfe) — schema pass LIVE-PROVEN 2026-07-15.

steps.name: show-auto-scaling-group
steps._note: Covers showautoscalinggroup. params:{} forces catalog key recording for GET steps.

steps.name: list-auto-scaling-groups-after-create
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggroups again to confirm the ASG appears. Separate step to show state after create.

steps.name: update-auto-scaling-group
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggroup. All fields optional per autoscalinggroupsetrequestv1dot2. CONFIRMED: do NOT include use_lb_state_check (even false triggers AutoScalingGroupLbStateCheckLbRequired when no LB attached). Send only desired_server_count_editable and state_check_delay_time.

steps.name: update-asg-server-count
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggroupservercount. Set desired_server_count=0 (no VMs to spin up).

steps.name: list-asg-virtual-servers
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggroupvirtualservers. Will return empty list since desired=0.

steps.name: list-asg-lb-server-groups
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggrouplbservergroups. Will return empty list.

steps.name: update-asg-lb-server-groups
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggrouplbservergroups. Body requires lb_server_groups array of objects {id, port}. Empty array = detach all (safe no-op since no LBs attached).

steps.name: create-asg-policy
steps._note: Covers createautoscalinggrouppolicy. Body confirmed: scale_type/scale_method/scale_value/metric_type/metric_method/comparison_operator/threshold/evaluation_minutes/cooldown_seconds. comparison_operator=ge (short-code). Captures $.id for policy_id.

steps.name: list-asg-policies
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggrouppolicies. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: show-asg-policy
steps._note: Covers showautoscalinggrouppolicy. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: update-asg-policy
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggrouppolicy. All fields optional per autoscalinggrouppolicyupdaterequestv1dot2. Send updated threshold + state=ACTIVE.

steps.name: delete-asg-policy
steps._note: Covers deleteautoscalinggrouppolicy.

steps.name: create-asg-schedule
steps._note: Covers createautoscalinggroupschedule. frequency=ONCE (no day_of_week needed). far-future start_date. Captures $.id for schedule_id.

steps.name: list-asg-schedules
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggroupschedules. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: show-asg-schedule
steps._note: Covers showautoscalinggroupschedule. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: update-asg-schedule
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggroupschedule. All optional per autoscalinggroupscheduleupdaterequest. Update description and state.

steps.name: delete-asg-schedule
steps._note: Covers deleteautoscalinggroupschedule.

steps.name: create-asg-notification
steps._note: Covers createautoscalinggroupnotification. REPAIR 2026-07-15 (run fe88 + agentB-repro 재현, agent-B): 종전 user_ids는 구계정(ec11538a…)의 사용자 f2b627e6…를 하드코딩 — 계정 교체(81eccb26…/732e2090…)로 무효가 되어 schedule 삭제 직후 이 스텝에서 lifecycle 사망(run ddbf=구계정 201, fe88·agentB-repro=신계정 실패; IAM 유저 목록은 403이라 사전조회 불가). 같은 lifecycle의 create-auto-scaling-group 응답 $.created_by(호출 주체 user id, 항상 유효)를 {asg_creator_id}로 캡처해 주입 — 계정 불변. notification_id captured from $.notifications[0].id (list envelope, NOT $.id). 정확한 4xx 코드는 오너 전체 정리로 라이브 재확인 미완 — 다음 전체 런 판정.

steps.name: list-asg-notifications
steps._note: Covers listautoscalinggroupnotifications. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: show-asg-notification
steps._note: Covers showautoscalinggroupnotification. params:{} for catalog key credit.

steps.name: update-asg-notification
steps._note: Covers updateautoscalinggroupnotification. Body: notification_events (optional array) + notification_state (optional string). Both optional per autoscalinggroupnotificationupdaterequest.

steps.name: delete-asg-notification
steps._note: Covers deleteautoscalinggroupnotification.

steps.name: delete-auto-scaling-group
steps._note: Covers deleteautoscalinggroup. Retry on 409 (state conflict) since ASG may be transitioning.

steps.name: delete-subnet
steps._note: Teardown subnet. Retry on 409 (ASG still holding subnet reference).

steps.name: delete-vpc
steps._note: Teardown VPC. Retry on 409.

steps.name: delete-security-group
steps._note: Teardown security group.

steps.name: delete-launch-configuration
steps._note: Teardown LC.

steps.name: delete-keypair
steps._note: Teardown keypair.
